ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution across approximately 95% of visible surface with high-intensity (white) pixels localized strictly to distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous low-intensity dark gray to black region covering the center and base of both lobes; high-contrast white/light-gray focal spots located at the terminal ends (tips) of both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; multiple small-amplitude peaks and valleys are visible, creating a jagged continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge sweeping upward and outward toward elevated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters detected at the distal tips of both lobes; individual circular patterns are partially visible within these clusters.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavily serrated trailing edge profile and significant depigmentation/scarring at the outer lobe tips.
